dashboard.quickNavigationInfo: These shortcuts take you to different areas of your child's learning profile. Each section shows different aspects of how AIVO is helping your child learn.

dashboard.subjectMasteryInfo: This shows how well your child has mastered each subject. Higher percentages mean stronger understanding. AIVO adjusts difficulty based on these scores.
dashboard.iepHeaderSubtitle: Track your child's individualized education goals and store important documents
dashboard.iepGoalsSubtitle: Track progress on individualized education plan goals
dashboard.iepGoalsInfo: IEP (Individualized Education Plan) goals are specific objectives set by your child's education team. Each goal has a target date and progress tracker. Green means on track, yellow means needs attention.
dashboard.accommodationsSubtitle: Active learning accommodations for your child
dashboard.accommodationsInfo: Accommodations are adjustments made to how your child learns. These don't change what they learn, but how they access the material — like extra time, visual aids, or simplified instructions.
dashboard.documentsSubtitle: Upload and manage IEP documents securely
dashboard.documentsInfo: Keep your child's IEP documents organized in one place. Upload PDF files of evaluations, meeting notes, or official IEP documents.

dashboard.masteryOverTimeSubtitle: See how learning improves week by week
dashboard.masteryOverTimeInfo: This chart shows your child's mastery percentage for each subject over time. An upward trend means they're improving! Use the subject filters to focus on one area.
dashboard.subjectBreakdownSubtitle: Detailed view of each subject's progress
dashboard.subjectBreakdownInfo: Each card shows a subject's current mastery level and whether it's trending up, down, or stable. 'Improving' means your child is getting better over time!

dashboard.inviteTeacherInfo: Since you manage this subscription, you can invite your child's teacher to view their AIVO learning data. Teachers get access to brain profile insights, accommodations, and progress reports.
dashboard.parentManagedAccountDesc: You control who has access. Teachers you invite can view learning data but cannot change settings or manage the subscription.
dashboard.inviteSentTeacher: Invitation sent! The teacher will receive an email to join.

dashboard.districtManagedAccountDesc: Your child's teacher set up this AIVO account through the school. You have full view access to your child's learning data.

brain.learnMoreGrowth: These are opportunities for growth. AIVO adapts its approach to gently build skills in these areas using your child's strengths.

brain.learnMoreSensory: These preferences help create the ideal learning environment. Share these with teachers and caregivers for consistent support.
brain.learnMoreCognitive: This chart shows how your child's thinking skills compare. Green dots mean strong skills, yellow means developing, and orange means areas getting extra support.
brain.learnMoreEngagement: This shows how much time your child spent learning each day and how focused they were. Higher focus scores mean deeper engagement.

brain.insightBestDay: Alex learns best during Thursday sessions with 89% focus. Consider scheduling key lessons on Thursdays.
brain.insightStrongestPathway: Visual Processing → Pattern Recognition is the strongest neural pathway (92%). Use this to scaffold weaker areas.
brain.insightGrowthArea: Auditory Processing remains a growth area. Consider visual-first instruction with optional audio reinforcement.
brain.functioningLevelHeaderSubtitle: How AIVO adapts its teaching approach to match your child's needs
brain.currentLevelSubtitle: Your child's current support tier and what it means
brain.currentLevelInfo: The functioning level determines how AIVO presents content to your child. Higher support levels use more visual aids, simpler language, and fewer choices. AIVO automatically suggests level changes based on your child's progress.
brain.activeAdaptationsSubtitle: How lessons are customized for your child right now
brain.activeAdaptationsInfo: These are the specific adjustments AIVO makes during lessons. They ensure your child can access learning content in a way that works best for them.
brain.levelHistorySubtitle: How your child's support level has changed over time
brain.levelHistoryInfo: This timeline shows when and why your child's functioning level was changed. Changes can happen through assessments, AI recommendations, or manual adjustments by your care team.
brain.standardDescription: Grade-level curriculum with standard expectations and regular progress checks.
brain.supportedDescription: Moderate support with visual scaffolding, simplified language, and regular check-ins.
brain.lowVerbalDescription: Picture-based support with minimal text, audio narration, and up to 3 choices.
brain.nonVerbalDescription: Symbol-based communication with partner support and up to 2 choices.
brain.preSymbolicDescription: Sensory-only engagement; adult-directed sessions with full partner assistance.

teacher.subjectMasterySubtitle: How this learner is progressing in each subject
teacher.subjectMasteryInfo: Subject mastery scores show how well the learner has demonstrated understanding. AIVO continuously adapts content difficulty based on these scores.
teacher.submitInsightSubtitle: Share your observations about this learner
teacher.submitInsightInfo: Your observations help AIVO fine-tune its approach for this learner. Notes about classroom behavior, social interactions, or learning breakthroughs are all valuable.
teacher.quickUploadIepSubtitle: Upload IEP documents for this learner
teacher.quickUploadIepInfo: Upload IEP documents to help AIVO better understand this learner's needs. Accepted formats: PDF, Word documents.

teacher.communicationStyleSubtitle: How to best communicate with this learner
teacher.communicationStyleInfo: Understanding communication preferences helps tailor instructions and feedback.
teacher.adaptationsSubtitle: How AIVO adapts for this learner

teacher.sensoryPreferencesInfo: Sensory preferences help create the optimal learning environment both digitally and in the classroom.

teacher.allAccommodationsSubtitle: Active support strategies for this learner
teacher.allAccommodationsInfo: These accommodations are derived from the learner's IEP and brain profile analysis. They're automatically applied during AIVO learning sessions.
teacher.allIepGoalsSubtitle: Track progress toward individualized education goals
teacher.allIepGoalsInfo: IEP goals are set collaboratively by the care team. AIVO tracks progress through session performance data and adaptive assessments.
teacher.noIepGoalsSet: No IEP goals have been set yet.

teacher.allSessionsInfo: Each session represents a learning interaction with AIVO. Sessions are scored based on accuracy and engagement metrics.
